learning_outcomes.description: 1.0 Understand safety and hygiene in a bakery environment

performance_criteria.description: Define Safety
Define food safety Hazards
Identify workplace hazards associated with bakery operations, including cross-contamination, burns, slips, cuts and electrical hazards.
Define personal hygiene practices
Carry out proper handwashing
Keep the work area clean and tidy
Clean tools according to Standard Operating Procedures.

learning_outcomes.description: 2.0 Safely handle and store bakery ingredients and products.

performance_criteria.description: Store dry raw materials according to safety standard
Store wet raw materials according to safety standard
Store finished goods according to safety standard
Handle food safely to maintain hygiene standards.
Safely dispose waste materials in the designated areas.

learning_outcomes.description: 3.0 Demonstrate compliance with security procedures in the bakery

performance_criteria.description: Follow security protocols regarding access to the bakery premises.
Report any safety or security hazards immediately to the supervisor.
Practice emergency procedures correctly
Identify workplace safety signs and their meanings.

learning_outcomes.description: 4.0 Understand first aid in baking and confectionery industry

performance_criteria.description: Define first aid
List the importance of first aid
List the component of a first aid box
Identify signs and symbols of first aid

units.title: Communication System in a Work Environment

learning_outcomes.description: 1.0 Understand the importance of good communication.

performance_criteria.description: Define Communication
List Types of work place Communication
State the importance of good communication in food production
List effective communication methods.
Demonstrate courteous, respectful and professional behaviour with colleagues, managers, and clients.

learning_outcomes.description: 2.0 Understand basic communication in the workplace

performance_criteria.description: Identify simple methods of communication used in a bakery (verbal, non-verbal, written).
Recognize common workplace instructions and signs.
Identify appropriate personnel to whom workplace issues should be reported to in the workplace.

learning_outcomes.description: 3.0 Understand interpersonal interactions.

performance_criteria.description: Use respectful speech and body language during workplace interactions.
Participate in meetings through appropriate information sharing.
Provide responses to customer and colleague queries.

learning_outcomes.description: 4.0 Communicate effectively with supervisors and colleagues

performance_criteria.description: Follow simple instructions from supervisors.
Ask questions politely when clarification is needed.
Respond appropriately to instructions and feedback.
Use respectful language when interacting with others.

learning_outcomes.description: 1.0 Communicate effectively with team members

performance_criteria.description: Define teamwork
Explain the importance of teamwork.
Follow simple verbal instructions from supervisors or colleagues.
Use polite and respectful language when interacting with team members.
Report issues (e.g., missing items, equipment faults) to the appropriate person.
Respond appropriately to feedback from team members.

learning_outcomes.description: 2.0 Perform assigned tasks as part of a team

performance_criteria.description: Carry out basic assigned duties (e.g., cleaning workspace) correctly.
Complete assigned tasks within specified timeline under supervision.
Assist team members when required.
Follow standard operating procedures during tasks.

learning_outcomes.description: 3.0 Maintain a positive attitude in a bakery team

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate a cooperative and helpful attitude.
Show respect for cultural and individual differences.
Maintain concentration while performing assigned duties.
Maintain a friendly and productive working environment.

learning_outcomes.description: 1.0 Understand the characteristics, functions, and proper selection of basic ingredients for bakery products.

performance_criteria.description: Identify major ingredients required for bread and confectionery products.
Describe the quality of ingredients based on sensory characteristics.
State the functions of ingredients.
Describe composite flours.

learning_outcomes.description: 2.0 Understand safe handling, hygienic storage procedures, and ingredient rotation.

performance_criteria.description: Define First-In-First-Out (FIFO)
Define First-Expired, First-Out (FEFO).
Explain stock rotation using the (FIFO) method.
Explain stock rotation using the (FEFO) method.
Store raw materials under approved storage conditions in accordance with food safety requirements.
Practice safe handling of perishable ingredients.

learning_outcomes.description: 3.0 Understand the principles of accurate weighing and measuring of raw materials for consistent production.

performance_criteria.description: Describe weighing scales according to Standard Operating Procedures.
Describe volumetric measurement according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
Describe ingredients measurement according to a given formulation.
Demonstrate accurate weighing of ingredients using digital and mechanical scales.

learning_outcomes.description: 1.0 Recognize common baking tools and equipment.

performance_criteria.description: Name mixing tools
Name measuring tools
Name cutting tools
Name baking tools
Classify tools according to their functions.
Match specific bakery products with their essential tools and pans.

learning_outcomes.description: 2.0 Select appropriate tools and equipment for specific baking tasks, following health and safety guidelines.

performance_criteria.description: Identify the correct tool for measuring dry ingredients.
Identify the correct tool for measuring liquid ingredients.
Select appropriate pans/tray for different bakery products.
Identify personal protective equipment (PPE) required for handling tools.

learning_outcomes.description: 3.0 Demonstrate safe handling of baking tools

performance_criteria.description: Handle tools carefully to avoid damage or injury.
Follow basic safety rules when using tools (e.g., avoid touching hot surfaces).
Use protective items such as oven gloves when necessary.
Maintain cleanliness during and after tool use.
Clean tools using appropriate materials according to food safety standards.
Inspect tools before storage and report defective equipment.
Identify damaged tools and report to supervisor/instructor.
Follow basic hygiene practices in handling tools.

learning_outcomes.description: 1.0 Recognize types of bread and confectionery products.

performance_criteria.description: Identify standard ingredients for dough.
Identify standard ingredients for batter.
Classify bread types
Distinguish basic confectionery items

learning_outcomes.description: 2.0 Identify basic baking and confectionery product types

performance_criteria.description: List common baking products such as bread, cakes, biscuits, and pastries.
Identify basic confectionery items such as sweets, chocolates, and simple desserts.
Recognize product types from pictures or real samples.
Group products correctly into baking or confectionery categories.

learning_outcomes.description: 3.0 Describe the basic production process for bread and confectionery products.

performance_criteria.description: Describe the stages of dough mixing.
Describe common mixing methods used in bakery production.
Explain mixing ingredients according to standard procedures.
Explain dough cutting processes
Explain dough fermentation
Describe use of ovens at correct temperatures.
Describe product quality based on texture
Describe product quality based on appearance

learning_outcomes.description: 1.0 Understand the necessity of baking measurements and ingredient weights

performance_criteria.description: Identify appropriate measuring tools for dry ingredients.
Identify appropriate measuring tools for liquid ingredients.
Differentiate between volume and weight measurements in a bakery.
State the importance of accurate measurements for product consistency.

learning_outcomes.description: 2.0 Understand proper techniques for measuring ingredients to ensure consistency, safety, and quality.

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate accurate weighing techniques for dry ingredients using scales.
Demonstrate accurate measurement of liquids using transparent measuring jugs.
Demonstrate correct levelling techniques for measuring spoon.

learning_outcomes.description: 3.0 Follow safety, sanitation, and waste reduction procedures regarding measurements.

performance_criteria.description: Maintain clean measuring tools
Follow safe handling procedures for all ingredients during the measuring process.
Measure ingredients in a manner that minimizes waste.

learning_outcomes.description: 1.0 Understand the importance of time management and sequence of operations in a bakery.

performance_criteria.description: Define mise en place
Arrange ingredients mise en place according to the daily production schedule.
Organize tools mise en place according to the daily production schedule.
Identify the correct sequence of baking stages for common bakery products.

learning_outcomes.description: 2.0 Understand individual and team workflow efficiently

performance_criteria.description: Work independently while following instructions
Participate effectively in team tasks when required.
Communicate simply with others
Follow directions from supervisors
Demonstrate cooperation and respect when working with others.

learning_outcomes.description: 3.0 Carrying out tasks within a given time frame following steps-by-steps instruction.

performance_criteria.description: Follows step-by-step instruction to perform tasks.
Completes tasks within the given time
Demonstrates basic awareness of time

units.title: Introduction to Industry Regulations, Bodies, and Stakeholders

learning_outcomes.description: 1.0 Know Industry Associations

performance_criteria.description: Identify common industry associations in baking and confectionery (PBAN, AMBCN, ICES)
State the roles of professional associations.
Explain the benefits of belonging to an association (training, standards, networking).
Explain how associations support industry development
Identify opportunities for skill development through associations

learning_outcomes.description: 2.0 Identify Industry Stakeholders

performance_criteria.description: Identify key stakeholders (producers, suppliers, customers, regulators)
Describe basic roles of each stakeholder in the industry
Explain the relationship between stakeholders in the value chain
Discuss awareness of customer expectations
Identify the importance of teamwork in meeting stakeholder needs

learning_outcomes.description: 3.0 Identify Key Regulatory Bodies in the Industry

performance_criteria.description: Identify key regulatory bodies such as NAFDAC and Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON)
State the basic roles of these regulatory bodies
Explain the importance of inspections and certifications
Identify basic documentation required by regulatory authorities
Explain the implications of non-compliance with regulatory requirements in the workplace

learning_outcomes.description: 4.0 Career path in baking and confectionery setting

performance_criteria.description: Explain career path
Identify the different career levels in baking and confectionery setting
Describe the duties and responsibilities associated with each career level
Outline opportunities for professional growth and specialization within the baking industry.
